title: UACP Vault Envelope
description: Encrypted, integrity-protected container carrying one or more UACP bundles plus optional opaque companion payloads, wrapped for one or more recipients. This is the uacp-vault-envelope OPTIONAL extension (v1.0.0). Crypto-agnostic at the schema level: algorithm identifiers are implementation-declared strings, not fixed enums.

uacp_vault_envelope.description: Extension version (semver) this envelope conforms to.

envelope_id.description: Opaque identifier for this envelope instance. MUST be randomly generated and MUST NOT be derived from, or otherwise reveal, any plaintext bundle content.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601, UTC, millisecond precision. Envelope creation time; immutable once set.

algorithm.description: Implementation-declared identifier for the per-recipient key-wrapping scheme (e.g. "x25519-sealedbox"). Not a closed enum — see spec §Algorithm identifiers.

recipient_id.description: Opaque per-recipient routing token (e.g. a public-key fingerprint). MUST NOT be derived from bundle content.

wrapped_key.description: base64url-encoded (RFC 4648 §5, no padding) ciphertext of the shared content key, wrapped for this recipient under key_wrap.algorithm.

algorithm.description: Implementation-declared identifier for the AEAD (or authenticated streaming AEAD) construct used to produce every entry's ciphertext under the shared content key (e.g. "xchacha20-poly1305-secretstream").

bundles.description: One or more encrypted UACP bundle entries. Each ciphertext MUST decrypt to a single UACP Conversation Object valid against schema/conversation.schema.json.

companion_payloads.description: Optional opaque encrypted companion payloads sharing this envelope's key wrap (e.g. a retrieval index, or application-defined side-channel state). Generic UACP consumers MUST treat these as opaque.

id.description: Opaque per-entry identifier. MUST be randomly generated, independent of any identifier inside the encrypted plaintext (e.g. MUST NOT copy the inner bundle's own `id` field).

ciphertext.description: base64url-encoded (RFC 4648 §5, no padding) ciphertext, produced under content_cipher.algorithm and the recipient-wrapped content key.

id.description: Opaque per-entry identifier, same requirements as encrypted_entry.id.

label.description: Optional implementation-defined category hint (e.g. "retrieval-index"). MUST be drawn from a small, implementation-documented set of category names, not per-instance data — it MUST NOT leak content.

ciphertext.description: base64url-encoded (RFC 4648 §5, no padding) ciphertext, produced under content_cipher.algorithm and the recipient-wrapped content key.
